title: Honda CBR250RR, average of SuperFlow stock and Dynojet Sport+ wheel curves (points read by eye)
source_note: SuperFlow WinDyn stock curve (blue) and Dynojet Research Sport+ curve (CBR250RRSportPlus.drf, 31.06 hp max, 19.16 Nm max) from images supplied by the user. Power points are read by eye from the images, about 1 hp accuracy. Averaged on purpose; the two tests differ in mode and conditions.
curve_method: Average of two wheel curves at 1000 rpm steps, 7,000 to 13,000 rpm. Stock SuperFlow alone peaks at about 35 hp near 13,000 rpm; Dynojet Sport+ peaks at 31.06 hp. The 5,000 and 6,000 rpm readings were removed: they implied 27 and 23 N·m, far above the rest of the curve. Peak torque is the torque implied by the averaged power points (hp × 7127 / rpm), which peaks at about 21.5 N·m at 10,000 rpm. The Dynojet Sport+ run alone reported 19.16 N·m.

6.measurement: V-box true speed, 6th gear, Sport+ mode
6.source: Otomotifnet road test as reported by indianautosblog.com; model year and MC51/SP variant not confirmed

notes: Gears 1 to 5 have no true-speed reference. Speedo readings (179 km/h in 6th, motoroids.com) are excluded. The earlier manufacturer crank figures (42 hp at 13,000 rpm, 25 N·m at 11,000 rpm) are no longer the target.
